lines.en: label yukidate5:
I tap on Yuki’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我点开手机里 Yuki 的名字，等她接。

lines.en: I don’t exactly call bearing great news or anything like that, but since Yumi seems adamant about keeping her distance, I should at least let Yuki know.
lines.zh: 我这通电话算不上带来什么好消息什么的，不过既然 Yumi 看起来铁了心要跟她保持距离，我至少该让 Yuki 知道。

lines.en: I’m sure she was expecting as much anyway.
lines.zh: 我猜她本来也就是这么预期的。

lines.en: I’m foolish for expecting anything else.
lines.zh: 我还指望别的什么，真是傻。

lines.en: : Yo. Sup?
lines.zh: : 哟。咋啦？

lines.en: : Hey. Are you doing anything tonight?
lines.zh: : 嘿。你今晚有事吗？

lines.en: : Nope. If I answer, just assume I ain’t doin’ shit.
lines.zh: : 没有。我要是接了，你就当我什么都没在干就行。

lines.en: : Want to meet up at the usual spot?
lines.zh: : 老地方见？

lines.en: : Are you paying again?
lines.zh: : 你又请客？

lines.en: : Ha. Not a chance.
lines.zh: : 哈。想都别想。

lines.en: : That was a one-time only thing, pal. Don’t have enough to be buying dinner for you every time we meet.
lines.zh: : 那可是仅此一次，老兄。我没钱到每次见面都给你买晚饭。

lines.en: : Aren’t you a fuckin’ teacher anyway? Figured you’d be pretty much loaded or some shit.
lines.zh: : 你不是个操蛋的老师吗？我还以为你挺有钱什么的。

lines.en: : Teachers don’t make as much as you think they do.
lines.zh: : 老师的收入没有你想象的那么高。

lines.en: : That so? Sucks.
lines.zh: : 是吗？那可真惨。

lines.en: : We’ll just buy our own shit then.
lines.zh: : 那我们就各买各的。

lines.en: : I’m close, so I’ll just wait for you there.
lines.zh: : 我离得近，就在那儿等你吧。

lines.en: : Not going to offer to give me a ride again?
lines.zh: : 不打算再提出载我一程了？

lines.en: : And waste my gas on someone who ain’t even buyin’ me dinner? Nah. You’re walking.
lines.zh: : 把我的油浪费在一个连晚饭都不请我吃的人身上？不了。你走路。

lines.en: : See you soon.
lines.zh: : 待会儿见。

lines.en: Yuki hangs up before I have the chance to retort and I quickly find myself shoving my hands back into my pockets and setting course for Tojo Ramen.
lines.zh: Yuki 在我来得及回嘴之前就挂了电话，我很快又把手塞回口袋，动身前往 Tojo Ramen。

lines.en: Tonight, I’m going to upset someone.
lines.zh: 今晚，我要让某个人难过。

lines.en: scene black
Well, probably at least.
lines.zh: 嗯，大概至少会。

lines.en: But I seem to inadvertently do that pretty often.
lines.zh: 不过这种事我似乎经常无意间就做了。

lines.en: Does something like this still count as inadvertent if it’s a situation that I manufactured entirely on my own?
lines.zh: 如果这个局面完全是我一手造成的，那它还算「无意」吗？

lines.en: Or do I need to rely on a term like “accident” and fall back on the hope that her own low expectations will act as a cushion for this poor turn of events?
lines.zh: 还是说我得依赖「意外」这种说法，然后指望她本就很低的期待能充当这糟糕转折的缓冲垫？

lines.en: There is only one way to find out.
lines.zh: 只有一个办法能知道答案。

lines.en: scene yukioutside1
: Yo.
I turn the corner to find Yuki waiting outside of Tojo Ramen and make my way over to her.
lines.zh: 我转过街角，发现 Yuki 正等在 Tojo Ramen 门外，便朝她走过去。

lines.en: I can smell cigarette smoke clinging to her jacket like her daughter clings to the hole inside of her heart.
lines.zh: 我能闻到烟味黏在她夹克上，就像她女儿黏在她心里那个洞上一样。

lines.en: A hole so big she can fit her fingers through it.
lines.zh: 那个洞大得能把手指穿过去。

lines.en: And, if she cares enough about her future, she might even have the chance to suture it back together.
lines.zh: 而如果她足够在乎自己的未来，她说不定还有机会把它缝合起来。

lines.en: Of course, there’s no chance it will ever work as well as the original version- the one that still had a mom.
lines.zh: 当然，它绝无可能像原版那样好用——那个还有妈妈的版本。

lines.en: But a heart is a heart.
lines.zh: 但心脏终究是心脏。

lines.en: Even if it’s ripped into pieces.
lines.zh: 哪怕它被撕成碎片。

lines.en: : Why are you out here? It’s freezing.
lines.zh: : 你怎么在外面？冻死了。

lines.en: : Is it?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.zh: : 冷这东西从来不太困扰我，大概吧。

lines.en: : But I imagine all those days of sleepin’ outside probably have somethin’ to do with that.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，那些年睡在外面的日子大概跟这有点关系。

lines.zh: : 可 Tsuneyo 总有那么多话要补充。

lines.zh: : 不，操蛋。在你答应戴套那件事之前别想换。

lines.en: : I agree to the “condom thing.” Now please stop talking about my entirely wholesome and not-at-all suspicious relationship with your daughter.
lines.zh: : 我答应「戴套那件事」。现在请你别再谈论我和你女儿那段完全纯洁、绝无可疑的关系了。

lines.en: : So, now what then?
lines.zh: : 那么，接下来怎么办？

lines.en: : You done hangin’ out with me now that you know Yumi’s not gonna be involved?
lines.zh: : 既然你知道 Yumi 不会掺和进来，你就不打算再跟我混了？

lines.en: : I was actually thinking of asking you the same thing.
lines.zh: : 我其实正想问你同样的问题。

lines.en: : You’re the one who wanted to check in on her and have made it very clear that our meetings aren’t dates.
lines.zh: : 是你想打听她的情况，而且你说得很清楚，我们的见面不是约会。

lines.en: : I just figured you wanted to probe someone close to her for info without really getting in the way.
lines.zh: : 我还以为你只是想从她身边的人嘴里套点信息，同时又不想真的碍事。

lines.en: : Well, yeah. That’s definitely true.
lines.zh: : 嗯，对。确实是。

lines.en: : You’re alright, though. We can still chill if you want.
lines.zh: : 不过你这人还不错。想的话我们还能继续混。

lines.en: : Not like I ever have anything to fuckin’ do.
lines.zh: : 反正我也从来没有什么操蛋的事可做。

lines.en: : No dates, though?
lines.zh: : 不过不约会？

lines.en: scene yukioutside16
: The fuck is it with you and all this dating shit?
lines.zh: : 你他妈怎么老是纠结约会这档子事？

lines.en: : There are like thirty different [teens] trying to jump your bones and you’re hitting on a recovering addict in her late 30’s.
lines.zh: : 大概有三十个不同的 [teens] 想扑到你身上，你却在撩一个快四十岁的戒断中的瘾君子。

lines.en: : I hit on virtually everyone. I’m sure you’ll get used to it.
lines.zh: : 我基本撩所有人。你肯定会习惯的。

lines.en: : We’ll see about that.
lines.zh: : 那我们就走着瞧。

lines.en: : I’m kind of staying out of the game for now, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我现在算是退出这个游戏了。

lines.en: : As you’ve heard, my track record with men is kind of shit.
lines.zh: : 正如你听到的，我跟男人的履历挺操蛋的。

lines.en: : I’m better off stayin’ a loner. And {i}you’re{/i} better off not gettin’ involved.
lines.zh: : 我还是一个人待着更好。而{i}你{/i}不掺和进来也更好。

lines.en: : ‘Specially since my daughter would kick your fucking ass if she found out we were together right now.
lines.zh: : 尤其是我女儿要是发现我们现在在一起，会他妈把你的屁股踢开花。

lines.en: : I’m going to keep this hidden from her at all costs. Don’t you worry.
lines.zh: : 我会不惜一切代价对她保密的。别担心。

lines.en: : Appreciated.
lines.zh: : 感激不尽。

lines.en: scene yukioutside17
: Oh, and sorry for dumping all of that shit on you tonight.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，抱歉今晚把这些破事全倒给你。

lines.en: : I realized halfway through that I was ventin’ to some dude who probably did not give two shits, but it’s been a long time since I’ve actually been able to say any of that.
lines.zh: : 说到一半我才意识到，我在对一个大概根本不在乎的老兄倒苦水，不过我已经很久很久没真的把这些说出口了。

lines.en: : Only other person in Kumon-mi who knows outside of the fuckin’ Yakuza is Tsu-chan.
lines.zh: : 在 Kumon-mi，除了那帮操蛋的黑道之外，唯一知道的人就是 Tsu-chan。

lines.en: : I can’t imagine Tsuneyo was very helpful in that regard.
lines.zh: : 我无法想象 Tsuneyo 在这方面能帮上什么忙。

lines.en: : She’s actually a really good listener.
lines.zh: : 她其实是个很好的倾听者。

lines.en: : Io, on the other hand...
lines.zh: : 至于 Io 嘛……

lines.en: : Yeah, it’s probably better if she never hears any of that.
lines.zh: : 是啊，她最好永远别听到这些。

lines.en: : Is this that “protecting kids” setting of yours that you were talking about earlier?
lines.zh: : 这就是你之前说的那个「保护孩子」模式？

lines.en: scene yukioutside18
: It’s the best I can do since mine has already given up on me.
lines.zh: : 既然我自己的孩子已经放弃我了，这就是我能做到的最好了。

lines.en: : They’re all good girls.
lines.zh: : 她们都是好女孩。

lines.en: : Hurt any one of them and I will rip your fucking dick off.
lines.zh: : 伤害她们中的任何一个，我就把你操蛋的鸡巴扯下来。

lines.en: : You and Yumi really do have a lot in common.
lines.zh: : 你和 Yumi 真的有很多共同点。

lines.en: scene black
Yuki and I head into Tojo Ramen and order a quick dinner.
lines.zh: Yuki 和我走进 Tojo Ramen，随便点了顿晚饭。

lines.en: It’s already really late by the time our food arrives, so we scarf it down, pay for ourselves and head on our way.
lines.zh: 等到食物上来时已经很晚了，所以我们狼吞虎咽吃完，各自付了钱就上路。

lines.en: I’m not exactly sure what this means for the beginning of our relationship-
lines.zh: 我不太确定这对我们关系的开端意味着什么——

lines.en: And I’m even less sure of how (And if) Yumi will ever fit into it.
lines.zh: 更不确定 Yumi 会如何（以及是否）融入其中。

lines.en: But at least I have one more person to talk to in the middle of the night now.
lines.zh: 但至少，现在深夜里我又多了一个可以说话的人。
